verdict.scope: the offline core boundary of candidate fa3985b only (no server, client, logging or analytics exists in this repository)
verdict.summary: The F08 input readers are closed and fail closed, every item is actively answered, the record is append-only, readiness replays are no-ops and no output claims a clearance. The boundary fails on the new-plan path: an intake flag the client can set (readinessDeclared) skips the clinical screen of the pause reason; once any readiness declaration is on record, a clinical cause stated in the restart intake, even a new injury after training resumed or an explicit clinicalReason yes, is never screened; and the hold check of a new plan depends on an optional, possibly stale referenceState because the record alone does not show standing holds. F08 rows are also trusted without ownership or causality checks, a strength readiness without restrictions defaults to none, and no erasure tombstone exists while deleting F08 rows fails open.
verdict.cycleNote: SEC-V1CPI-01..05 are new, narrow and runtime-only, so they fit the task contract's single bounded fix cycle. SEC-V1CPI-06 needs the SEC-V1CP-14 tombstone design (Engineering with SSCTR); if it is not designed in that cycle it closes as a named blocker before any erasure path or real collection.
verdict.invalidatedBy: any change to v1-f08.mjs readers or facts, restartIntake/restartProgram, canonicalizeIntake pause or restart handling, the F08 handlers in r6-adaptation.mjs, the record facts, or any outbound surface

conditions.title: Closed structure, fail closed
evidence: readWellbeing, readCheck and readReadiness accept only their listed keys (v1-f08.mjs:63, 105, 128, 141): extra keys text, professionalSeen, notes, medication, doctorName, diagnosis, symptoms, professionalVisitDate, temperature, doctorCleared, clearanceDate, professionalName each give ASK naming the key (p1).

Out-of-vocabulary values give ASK, never a default: condition COVID or lower case, intent TRAIN_HARDER, region LEFT_KNEE or lower case, sports SWIM, a string or [], returnSpeed TURBO, days 2, 15, 3.5 or '5', a start date other than today, an inconsistent or malformed endDate, an unknown sign key (cancer), an own __proto__ key, an unknown sport or sub-key, ready 'yes', a free-text or unknown restriction, restrictions as a string, readiness returnSpeed FASTER (p1: 85 checks pass).
Defaults exist only for training preferences: returnSpeed absent reads BALANCED (SSCTR Q06/Q07 default).

FAILED by SEC-V1CPI-01: the restart intake accepts internal fields from the client (athlete.pause.readinessDeclared, athlete.pause.bySportDays; r6-intake.mjs:205). readinessDeclared skips the clinical screen of the pause reason: generateProgram with pause {weeks:6, reasonCategory:'INJURY', reason:'surgery on my knee', readinessDeclared:true} gives PROPOSED, the same pause without the flag gives CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED (p3 RS-g). bySportDays {RUN:0, STRENGTH:0} turns a stated 6-week pause from run class RESTART into EASY_CURRENT (p7). The security record allows 'existing intake fields only' for the restart intake.
FAILED by SEC-V1CPI-05: a strength readiness without a restrictions key reads as no restriction (v1-f08.mjs:144), a default on a hard-cap item (RC-08 'no defaults').
Also SEC-V1CPI-08 (unknown key names echoed) and SEC-V1CPI-09 (contradictory or unused values accepted instead of ASK).
conditions.outsideCore: server-side closed schema (additionalProperties false, strict booleans) rejecting before the core: PENDING, Engineering

conditions.title: No prefilled health answers; every item actively answered
evidence: Every warning sign of each condition is required: removing any one asks exactly that key (MILD_INDISPOSITION 15, UNUSUAL_FATIGUE 13, MILD_ILLNESS 15, MINOR_DISCOMFORT 9, NEED_REST 9 items); an unknown condition asks all 15 (p1).
Non-boolean answers 'no', 'false', 0, null, 'NO' are unknown (ASK), never no; shortcuts true, false, 'ALL_NO', [], {all:false}, {none:true}, null give ASK (p1; readBooleans, v1-f08.mjs:51-54).

Each exercise-response item is required once sessions were executed; improved is required at the window end and refused elsewhere; readiness asks each of W1-W15, declaredRecovered must be true, ready must be boolean per programmed sport, and runningNotRestricted is required with AVOID_LOWER_BODY_STRENGTH (p1).
The six eligibility flags must be booleans with a current date (r6-adaptation.mjs:491), dated today for the Situation 1 entry (1183) and the readiness (1381); a clinical flag routes first (488).
A yes on any sign, asked or not, routes the clinical hold (fail safe; p1). Unknown never reads as illness: the ASK reasons say 'unknown is neither clearance nor illness'.
JS-API note: inherited (prototype) properties are read as answers; JSON input cannot produce them, so the server must pass parsed JSON only.
conditionsToClose: SEC-V1CPI-05 fixed (restrictions must be answered: an empty list means none)
the A1 clinicalReason answer is defeated on the restart path by SEC-V1CPI-02 (ruled under SEC-V1CP-23)
conditions.outsideCore: UI: every control starts unanswered, one by one, no all-no control, no copy from an earlier screen: PENDING, Product/UX and Engineering (client)

conditions.title: professionalSeen dropped
evidence: professionalSeen, doctorName, professionalName, professionalVisitDate, doctorCleared and clearanceDate give ASK in all three readers and are never read (p1).
No F08 record fact or decision record has a professional-visit field (WELLBEING_DECLARED, WELLBEING_CHECKED and READINESS_DECLARED keys inspected, p2).
The F08 handlers read only review.eligibility, review.event.id, review.wellbeing, review.wellbeingCheck and review.readiness (r6-adaptation.mjs:1063-1420).

conditions.title: No free text in the F08 inputs
evidence: text, notes, symptoms and temperature give ASK in the report and the check; a free-text restriction gives ASK; no free-text field is read by any F08 handler; free text never opens a reduction or a restart (RC-05).
Condition: unknown key names are echoed verbatim and unbounded into reason and missingInputs and persisted in referenceState.pending (SEC-V1CPI-08).
Condition: the object of a sport the plan does not program is not validated, so its free text is ignored instead of asked (SEC-V1CPI-09).

conditions.title: Erasure fails closed in a hash-bound record
evidence: Append-only and hash-bound half VERIFIED: every F08 row seen during a timeline is in the final ledger and unchanged (p2: rows carried unchanged; no row dropped); each row has inputHash; decisions are covered by programHash; a tampered or foreign referenceState gives HOLD (p4).

Erasure half not met: no tombstone exists for F08 rows (the only 'tombstone' in src is the R2 SUPPRESSED marker in semantics.mjs, unrelated); the BEFORE_IMPLEMENTATION evidence (tombstone design plus regression) is absent.

Deleting F08 rows fails open (SEC-V1CPI-06): with the READINESS_DECLARED row removed, a new plan drops AVOID_LOWER_BODY_STRENGTH (0 lower-body rows with the row, 32 without; p4 ER); with an open window's WELLBEING_DECLARED row removed, a new report opens a second window over the first (C-Q05-2, RC-06 bypassed) while the old WAIT markers keep 0 of 10 sessions live with no answerable check (p5 ER1).
inputHash hashes the raw input (v1-f08.mjs:96, 118, 162), so it is reversible by enumeration of the closed vocabulary: SEC-V1CP-15 applies (PENDING outside the core).

conditions.title: Copy never claims clearance or diagnosis
evidence: 1,715,114 output strings scanned over Situation 1 (every condition with each allowed intent, three speeds, 4 and 12 days, window weeks and return weeks), the sign routes, not improved, Situation 2 variants and restart weeks, and Situation 3 (p6), against cleared, clearance, clear to, approved, released, fit to train or run, safe, authorized, permitted, liberado, liberação, dado de alta, alta médica, apto, autorizado, aprovado, recovered, cured, healed, diagnosis, healthy.

Four distinct hits, none a claim: 'answering no to all of them is never a clearance' (r6-adaptation.mjs:1205), 'This is your statement, not a medical clearance' (1416, twice), and the item question 'that you recovered' (v1-f08.mjs:159).

Reasons attribute to the athlete ('You told us', 'You reported'); the sign route names only what was reported and derives no diagnostic label from combinations (v1-f08.mjs:49); the readiness record keeps cause CLINICAL and nonclinical false; the core produces no certificate, file or export.
Conditions: SEC-V1CPI-11 (negated disclaimers must not be rendered with denylisted words; urgent-care guidance for W2-W5 and X1 is undifferentiated in the core).
conditions.outsideCore: string scan of the PT-BR, EN and ES catalogs; no readiness artifact in any screen or export: PENDING, Product/UX with PCG; G07/G11 final

conditions.title: Readiness declaration integrity
evidence: Own hold only: with no hold the declaration is a KEEP and records nothing; an open Situation 1 window is not a hold; a foreign or tampered referenceState gives HOLD; the holds come from the validated referenceState and from breaks that pass readableDeclaration (p4; r6-adaptation.mjs:32, 529, 792, 1372).
Screen dated that day: yesterday keeps the hold (eligibility.assessedToday); tomorrow, or a flag unanswered, is not accepted; a clinical flag keeps the hold (p4).

Append-only and replay-deduplicated: same eventId and payload is a KEEP with one row; same eventId with another payload is ASK; the old declaration replayed after a new hold does not restart (p2; r6-adaptation.mjs:1373-1374).
Never edits the reason: the INTERRUPTION_DECLARED reasonCategory stays ILLNESS; the decision keeps cause CLINICAL (S2-1). A new sign returns to the hold and a new declaration is needed (S2-3, p2).
While a hold stands, NOT_FEELING_100, WELLBEING_CHECK, RECOVERED and a readiness that also declares a break open nothing (p8).

Conditions: SEC-V1CPI-07 (a same-day screen answered before the hold's sign, and a previous-local-day screen sent in UTC, are accepted); SEC-V1CPI-04 (F08 rows trusted without ownership checks); SEC-V1CPI-09 (the hold field is never compared with the holds on record).
conditions.outsideCore: server ownership on every read and write, eventId deduplication across devices, device-owner authentication SHOULD (G09): PENDING, Engineering

conditions.title: A restart plan is not a bypass
evidence: VERIFIED with the latest referenceState: a clinical-cause break, a Situation 1 entry sign, a not-improved window end, a clinical eligibility flag, pain with a substitution and a warning sign during the S6 restart each block the new plan (p3 RS-a..e: CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED). Restrictions in force carry over (0 lower-body rows); a sport not declared ready is not programmed; the new plan starts at the return entry (run class RESTART; strength at most 1 set at RIR 4 or more) (S3-1, p3).

Minimal carry VERIFIED: the new program embeds no record row, no free text and no sign answer; it carries restart {readinessEventId, strengthRegions, minimumClass, fromRecord} and pause {weeks, bySportDays, readinessDeclared marker}; the record is returned whole beside the program (restart.carriedRecord; p7b, r6-index.mjs:33-37).

FAILED by SEC-V1CPI-02: once any readiness is on record, a clinical cause stated in the restart intake is never screened. Training resumed after the declaration, then a stop: pause {reasonCategory:'INJURY', reason:'tore a ligament two weeks after restarting', clinicalReason:true} gives PROPOSED, the same intake outside the restart gives CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED (p3b). INJURY, 'knee surgery last month', ILLNESS and clinicalReason:true right after the declaration also give PROPOSED (p3 RS-f).
FAILED by SEC-V1CPI-01: a client-set readinessDeclared gives PROPOSED for an INJURY pause through restartProgram with no readiness on record (p3 RS-g).

FAILED by SEC-V1CPI-03: without the referenceState the record alone does not block. The S1 entry sign, not-improved, flag and substitution holds give ASK (only the missing pause reason) and then PROPOSED once a nonclinical reason is stated (p3 RS-a..d, p4 RO, p3c); the S6 warning-sign hold gives PROPOSED directly, and so does the referenceState of the decision before the sign (p3 RS-e).
Also SEC-V1CPI-04: a READINESS_DECLARED row of another athlete dated 2099 removes AVOID_LOWER from the new plan even with the latest referenceState (32 lower-body rows; p3 RS-h).
conditions.outsideCore: the server keeps the carried record by reference, with no duplicate store: PENDING, Engineering

vocabularyRuling.scope: the SSCTR warningSignInstrument (W1-W15, X1-X4, the improvement question) and Q07 additions (runningNotRestricted) introduced under SEC-V1CP-02 and C-Q05-8, plus the region values WHOLE_BODY, UPPER_BODY and LOWER_BODY
vocabularyRuling.basis: Each item is a closed boolean or enum with a named decision consumer, asked only where that consumer applies, never free text; the stored record keeps less than is asked. The confirmation is of minimisation and grouping only: it is not a clinical validation (FUTURE_G04_REVALIDATION) and it does not authorise real collection until the conditions below hold.

items.items: W1-W9 (fever or chills; chest pain, pressure or tightness; breathless at rest; palpitations at rest; fainting, near-fainting or dizziness; pain that changes movement; swelling; injury from a fall or impact; getting worse)
items.consumer: any yes routes the clinical hold for every sport (RF-3): at entry, each weekly review inside the window and the ladder, the window end, the readiness and the S6 weekly check
items.grouping: asked for every condition; separate items are justified because a single 'any of these' control is the all-no shortcut SEC-V1CP-03 forbids, and the splits (W3/W4, W6/W7) answer distinct signs
items.storage: entry: no sign answer stored (only inputHash); checks: the asked items as answered no, or the yes items (signsYes) on the clinical route; readiness: all no (a yes keeps the hold and records nothing)

items.items: W10, W12, W13, W14 (body-wide aches; vomiting, diarrhoea, nausea or abdominal pain; moderate or severe cough; severe headache)
items.grouping: only for the systemic conditions MILD_ILLNESS, MILD_INDISPOSITION and UNUSUAL_FATIGUE (signsFor, v1-f08.mjs:34; verified)

items.items: W11, W15 (exhaustion at rest; severe or persistent nose or throat symptoms)
items.grouping: only for the illness-type conditions, so training fatigue alone is not routed clinical (verified)

items.note: all fifteen are asked because the cause of the hold is not read again (I-12); proportionate for ending a clinical hold, and only no answers are ever stored there

items.items: X1-X4 (breathless, chest pain, dizzy or racing heart with exercise; much higher effort than usual; new muscle or joint pain with exercise; very dark brown or red urine after exercise)
items.grouping: asked only after sessions executed or reported adverse inside a window, a ladder or an S6 restart, and at their weekly reviews; X3 only for illness-type windows (verified)
items.minimisation: compound items stay compound (no split into finer symptoms); X4 is the most sensitive item and stays a boolean: never a follow-up question, a value, a photo or a description

items.consumer: the window-end check: the return starts, or persistence routes to assessment (NEED_REST to a break or a new plan)
items.note: required at the window end and refused elsewhere (verified)

items.consumer: running restarts or stays held when strength is declared with AVOID_LOWER_BODY_STRENGTH (Q07, PCG Q4 f)
conditions: a false answer is never ignored: with ready true it is a contradiction to ask (SEC-V1CPI-09)
the question is worded without a double negative and maps exactly to the key (Product/UX)

items.note: UPPER/LOWER stays the finest body granularity (no joint, side or anatomical site); systemic conditions take only WHOLE_BODY or none (verified)
conditions: a region is asked and stored only when strength is an affected sport (SEC-V1CPI-09)

groupingRules: Keep the per-condition item sets exactly as signsFor and exerciseSignsFor define them; the client shows the set the core asks for.
No new item, sub-item, 'other symptom' field, severity scale, duration, temperature or other value, medication, cause or diagnosis label; the app never derives a label from a combination of answers.
The chronic-condition gap (IOC checklist question 2) is not closed with a new health field without Security and G07; until then it is disclosed with the release (SSCTR disclosedGap).
Any change to the instrument re-triggers this ruling (C-Q05 reReviewTrigger).
beforeAnyRealCollection: G07: legal basis for each operation (art. 11 I specific and highlighted consent for the adaptation; whether art. 11 II covers the red-flag routing), consent text in PT-BR, EN and ES recorded with language and version (SEC-V1CP-10), a RIPD recommended (art. 38).
G07 and Engineering with SSCTR: retention periods, per-episode deletion and the SEC-V1CP-14 tombstone, designed and regression-tested (SEC-V1CPI-06).

G04 (unavailable) with interim wording to the Founder per DR-148: the instrument content and the urgency wording; chest pain, breathlessness, palpitations, fainting (W2-W5) and X1 carry urgent-care guidance (SEC-V1CP-21, SEC-V1CPI-11).
Product/UX: every item starts unanswered and is answered one by one with no all-no control (SEC-V1CP-03); no free-text field in these flows (SEC-V1CP-05); runningNotRestricted asked unambiguously.

Engineering: a server-side closed schema mirroring the core vocabulary rejects before the core; no field, value, hash or derived label reaches logs, metrics, crash reports, analytics, push, OS surfaces or shares (SEC-V1CP-09, 15, 16, 17, 18), proven by the canary test; protection at rest and in transit (SEC-V1CP-20); server custody of the record (SEC-V1CPI-04).

Core: SEC-V1CPI-01 to SEC-V1CPI-05 fixed with directed tests, and SEC-V1CPI-07 to SEC-V1CPI-10 resolved, because the same instrument and record feed the restart path; then a Security re-verification of the fixed revision.
vocabularyRuling.notRuledHere: trainingMonths (C-Q03-6) and the race 'tolerated' answer (C-Q04-2) were also escalated by the SSCTR to Security/G07 but are outside this brief; they stay PENDING (see pending[]).

findings.title: Internal restart fields are accepted from the client intake; readinessDeclared skips the clinical screen of the pause reason
findings.scenario: generateProgram(HYBRID with athlete.pause {weeks:6, reasonCategory:'INJURY', reason:'surgery on my knee', readinessDeclared:true}) gives status PROPOSED with pause.screen READINESS_DECLARED; the same pause without the flag gives CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED. restartProgram with no readiness on record and the flag set gives PROPOSED. pause {weeks:6, reasonCategory:'TRAVEL', nonclinical:true, bySportDays:{RUN:0, STRENGTH:0}} makes the run class EASY_CURRENT instead of RESTART.
findings.impact: Any intake (onboarding or new plan) can switch off the A1 screen of the pause reason with an undocumented boolean, so a clinical cause gets a plan; a client-supplied bySportDays silently overrides the stated pause toward the less conservative start.
findings.required: canonicalizeIntake never reads readinessDeclared, bySportDays or any other restart-derived field from client input (input carrying them is an input error or ASK); restartIntake passes what it derives from the record out of band; directed tests on both entry points.

findings.title: After any readiness declaration on record, a clinical cause stated in the restart intake is never screened
findings.scenario: A clinical-cause break (ILLNESS 'flu'), a readiness declaration, weeks 3 to 5 trained (last executed 2026-12-19), then a stop. restartProgram with the latest referenceState and intake pause {reasonCategory:'INJURY', reason:'tore a ligament two weeks after restarting', clinicalReason:true}, weeks left to the record, gives PROPOSED with pause.screen READINESS_DECLARED; the same intake outside the restart gives CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED (p3b). Right after the declaration, INJURY, 'knee surgery last month', ILLNESS and clinicalReason:true also give PROPOSED (p3 RS-f).
findings.impact: A relevant sign is ignored: the person's own clinical category, clinical mention or explicit 'yes, it was clinical' leads to a new plan. This is the task contract's ESCALATE_IF trigger 'a relevant sign being ignored'.
violates: PCG RC-11 ('any current sign still routes')
findings.required: Screen every reason, category and clinicalReason the athlete states in the restart intake. Let the declaration stand in only for the historic episode it answered: no stated reason, or a stated cause matched to that episode, and no executed training after the declaration. Otherwise route clinical, or ASK whether it is the declared episode. The matching rule is SSCTR/PCG content under RC-11; the interim fail-closed behaviour (screen) needs no new authority.
findings.owner: Engineering; SSCTR and PCG for the RC-11 matching rule

findings.title: The hold check of a new plan depends on an optional, possibly stale referenceState; the record alone does not show standing holds
findings.scenario: A Situation 1 report with chest pain yes (hold). restartProgram(intake with pause TRAVEL, nonclinical, record) without referenceState gives PROPOSED; with it, CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED (p4 RO). The not-improved, clinical-flag and substitution-pain holds behave the same: ASK for the missing pause reason (p3 RS-b..d), then PROPOSED once the intake states a nonclinical TRAVEL pause, against CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED with the referenceState (p3c). A warning sign during the S6 restart: without referenceState, PROPOSED directly; with the referenceState of the decision before the sign, PROPOSED (p3 RS-e).
findings.cause: restartProgram defaults referenceState to null and never validates it; restartIntake reads only referenceState.pending and INTERRUPTION_DECLARED rows after the latest readiness, not the record's WELLBEING_CHECKED rows with signsYes or improved false, nor a chained report routed clinical; the Situation 1 entry sign route records no fact at all.
findings.note: Relying on referenceState for holds that exist only as a continuation is pre-existing in evaluateProgram: a weekly review of the same program without it also loses the Situation 1 entry hold (KEEP). V1CP extends the pattern to the new Situation 1 route and to the new restart API, where an integrator may treat the old program's state as obsolete. The uncommitted INTEGRATION_CONTRACT_V1CP.md asks the client to send the last referenceState; that is documentation, not enforcement.
violates: SEC-V1CP-23 ('enforced in the core, not only in the UI')
PCG RC-15 (state from the record, never from a client dropping the continuation)
findings.required: restartProgram refuses (ASK) without a valid same-athlete referenceState whenever the record is not empty, and rejects one older than the record's latest fact; restartIntake also reads the record's F08 clinical facts after the latest readiness; consider an append-only minimal hold fact for routes that today live only in referenceState.pending (Situation 1 entry sign, clinical flag, pain with a substitution) so that the record alone shows a standing hold (R-F08-1 'on record'). Directed tests for every hold source with the referenceState absent and stale.
findings.owner: Engineering; PCG and SSCTR if a new record fact is introduced

findings.title: F08 rows in the carried record are read without ownership, causality or integrity checks
findings.scenario: A WELLBEING_CHECKED row with athleteId 'someone-else', inputHash 'x', kind WINDOW_END and improved true appended to the ledger: the next weekly review treats the return as started (the window-end check is skipped) and keeps the row (p2 LT). A READINESS_DECLARED row with athleteId 'someone-else' dated 2099: restartProgram with the latest referenceState drops AVOID_LOWER_BODY_STRENGTH (0 to 32 lower-body rows); without the referenceState it also unlocks a new plan over a clinical break (p3 RS-h).
findings.impact: A record assembled across accounts, or a ledger the client can submit, changes F08 state and restrictions; the baseline protects INTERRUPTION_DECLARED rows against exactly this.
findings.required: One readable-F08 predicate (athleteId equals the program's, eventId a string, declaredAt a valid instant not after the decision, the shape of the fact type, an integrity hash over the stored fact) applied in evaluateProgram and in restartIntake; a failing row gives HOLD, never silently honoured or dropped. Server custody of the record stays PENDING.

findings.title: A strength readiness without restrictions reads as 'no restriction'
findings.scenario: readiness sports {RUN:{ready:true}, STRENGTH:{ready:true}} with no restrictions key gives restrictions [] (p1), and strength restarts on every region.
findings.impact: An omitted answer to a hard-cap item (RC-09) becomes the less conservative value.
violates: PCG RC-08 ('every item actively answered, no defaults')
PCG re-ruling (restrictions among the actively answered items)
findings.required: When strength is declared ready, require an explicit array (empty means none); absent gives ASK; directed test.

findings.title: No erasure tombstone for F08 rows, and deleting them fails open
findings.scenario: A Situation 1 sign hold, then a readiness with AVOID_LOWER_BODY_STRENGTH: restartProgram with the readiness row removed gives PROPOSED with 32 lower-body rows (0 with the row), although the old program still carries the STRENGTH_RESTRICTION marker (p4 ER). An open window's WELLBEING_DECLARED row removed: the window-end check says 'nothing to check', 0 of 10 sessions are live over the next two weeks, and a new report opens a second window over the first (p5 ER1).
findings.impact: A per-episode deletion (SEC-V1CP-13) would lift a restriction or bypass the chaining guard (C-Q05-2, RC-06), or leave the athlete with no legitimate way back (B6).
findings.required: The tombstone design: an append-only erasure marker the core reads as clinical-cause, restriction in force or episode unknown, never as absent, with integrity kept; regressions for each F08 fact; no erasure path for F08 rows is exposed before it.
findings.owner: Engineering with SSCTR; retention basis G07

findings.title: Screen currency is day-granular and timezone-naive
findings.scenario: A hold at 10:00 (fever yes); the readiness at 12:00 with a screen assessedAt 07:00 the same day gives READINESS_RESTART. A screen answered at 23:00 local the previous day and sent as 2026-11-17T02:00:00Z is accepted as today's (p4).
findings.required: Read assessedAt in the program's local time; when it carries a time, require it after the hold's instant (referenceState.asOf or the latest clinical fact); otherwise the server binds a screen answered within the declaration flow.

findings.title: Unknown key names are echoed verbatim and unbounded, and persisted in referenceState.pending
findings.scenario: A report with the key 'I take insulin and my cardiologist said no running' gives an ASK whose reason and missingInputs contain the text, and referenceState.pending.reason contains it; a 200,000-character key gives a pending reason of 200,090 characters (p2). The text is never read for a decision and never reaches the ledger.
violates: SEC-V1CP-16 risk (reasons are a common log field)
findings.required: Report unknown keys without echoing them (a count or a fixed token) and bound any echoed path; directed test.

findings.title: Contradictory or unused values are accepted instead of asked
findings.scenario: RUN {ready:true, runningNotRestricted:false} with no lower restriction reads as ready; in a running-only plan, sports.STRENGTH {ready:'??', restrictions:['free text: torn ACL'], anything:'else'} is accepted unvalidated (not stored in the fact, inside inputHash); hold {episodeId:'someone-elses-episode'} is accepted and never compared with the holds on record (the fact stores the record's holds); a running-only report with region LOWER_BODY stores region LOWER with no strength row affected (p1, p7).

findings.title: WELLBEING_CHECKED replays are deduplicated only in the WELLBEING_CHECK handler
findings.scenario: Inside an episode, a WEEKLY_REVIEW with the same event id and the same check replayed gives a second MODIFY with a fourth decision and two WELLBEING_CHECKED rows with eventId 'wr-G' (p5). A plain weekly review replay is a KEEP with no proposal on the candidate and on FREEZE-6 (p5b, p5c). A WELLBEING_CHECK reusing the report's eventId is accepted: two rows of two fact types with one id (p2).
violates: SEC-V1CP-22 replay rule applied to the F08 record
findings.required: Deduplicate every F08 row by eventId across fact types before recording; a replayed weekly review that carries a check is a no-op; directed test.

findings.title: Copy dependencies: negated disclaimers and undifferentiated urgency
findings.scenario: The core says 'never a clearance' and 'not a medical clearance' (and 'a current clear screen' in a counterfactual); a literal PT-BR rendering ('não é uma liberação médica') trips the SEC-V1CP-21 denylist. Chest pain, breathlessness, palpitations and fainting get the same 'seek a professional assessment' as swelling; the yes items are returned (warningSigns) so the client can key urgent copy.
violates: SEC-V1CP-21 (catalog scan; urgent-care guidance for red flags such as chest pain or fainting)
findings.required: Catalog copy in PT-BR, EN and ES keeps the meaning without denylisted words, or PCG with G07 approves a negated-disclaimer rule; urgent-care guidance for W2-W5 and X1, with interim wording routed to the Founder while G04 is unavailable (DR-148); a string scan of the catalogs.
